name: Asahina Masaomi
source:
Birth Date: 1979/04/24.
Occupation: Pediatrician.

Masaomi is the eldest son of the Asahina family. He works as a pediatrician, which fits his children-loving and gentle personality. Ever since their father passed away, Masaomi has been taking care of [url=/c12980]Wataru[/url] and becomes the father figure of his life. He rarely snaps or gets angry over anything, but he turns incredibly terrifying when he does. Masaomi is rather laid-back, and he spends most of his free time relaxing at home. He loves his family a lot.

[from [url=http://koiiro.wordpress.com/2012/06/17/brothers-conflict-passion-pink-masaomi/]Love-Colored Sky[/url]]
